description.description: Free text shown in the viewer.

phases.description: The phases, run in order. `done` of one phase enters the next.

events.description: Custom events this workflow can wait on, by name.

board.description: Reference to a board file (`std/board`). Layered over the library board.

params.description:
Typed params of the workflow, set by the binding's `with`. Phase
entries pass them down as `{param: <name>}`.

on.description:
Task-wide handlers, tried in order on every event in any phase, wait
or running step; the first match wins.

commands.description:
Commands every wait accepts unless it declares its own of the same name (a default
route per command). Lint requires `retry` once this block exists.

description: A workflow file: an ordered list of phases.
title: WorkflowFile

id.description: Unique id in this workflow. Defaults to the last segment of `use`.

exits.description:
Where each exit goes. Unmapped `done` enters the next phase; any other
unmapped exit ends the task with the exit name as status.

max_entries.description:
How often the phase may be entered (default 5). A number,
`{param: <name>}` of the workflow, or a template over `params`.

on_limit.description:
The exit taken instead of entering the phase once more than
`max_entries` times (default `limit_reached`).

anyOf.description: `next` (the following phase) or the id of any phase, earlier or later.
End the task with this status.

NumField.description:
An integer field: a number, `{param: <name>}`, or a string: a duration
(`90s`, `15m`, `2h`, `14d`, `1w`, where durations are allowed) or a
template (`"{{ params.rounds * 2 }}"`) rendering to one.

default.description: Value used when the caller gives none. A param without a default is required.

Param.description: A typed parameter of a phase or step file.

oneOf.description: A MiniJinja prompt template: inline text or `{file: path}`.

events.description: Events that trigger the handler (same matchers as a wait).

from.description: Default sender requirement for matchers without `from` (default `anyone`).

if.description: Extra condition (an expression; `event` is the candidate).

set.description: Task variables assigned when the handler fires (see node `set`).

do.description:
What to do: `cancel` (end with status `cancelled`), `end:<status>`,
`goto:<phase id>` or `stop_step`. Without `do` the handler only
assigns `set` and the event is still offered to the step or wait.

Handler.description: A task-wide event handler (`on:` of a workflow).

Matcher.description: An event matcher: a type name, or a type with a sender requirement and condition.

if.description: MiniJinja expression over the task document; `event` is the candidate.

oneOf.description: The actor must have write access (`actor.can_write`, supplied by the engine).

name.description: The command word without the slash (a text field: `{param: approve_command}`).

label.description: Button and list label (default: the command).

description.description: One line for the UI and the reply to a command that does not apply.

hidden.description:
Still accepted when typed, but not offered as a button (left out of the projection's
`commands`). Hides an inherited default such as `retry` where it makes no sense.

CommandDecl.description:
A command (`/name` in a comment, or a UI button) a wait accepts.

`to` is where the command goes: a node of the wait's phase, `exit:<name>` (leave the phase
through that exit), `start` (the phase's first node), `self` (this wait again) or
`goto:<phase id>` (enter a top-level phase). Without `to` the wait's own `next:` rules
route the command; the declaration only lists it. `/cancel` is engine-native.

TextField.description:
A text field: a string (a MiniJinja template when it contains `{{`/`{%`)
or `{param: <name>}`.
